body.prose: Each quality carries an open problem of definition or measurement: what counts as ethical, how effectiveness is scored, how bias is found as it happens, how awareness is built.
body.title: What the qualities cannot yet measure

body.matters: the relation between a system and its rehearsal
body.prose: Simulation is turned inward: the holons become actors in a copy of their own system, and the copy can stop, flag and send findings upward.
body.title: The system that rehearses itself

body.matters: whether the modelled entity also directs
body.prose: The line runs from agents whose local acts yield unplanned global patterns, to holons that also steer the run that models them.
body.title: From emergence to direction

body.matters: the mirroring of holon and double
body.prose: Each key holon gets a federate double, including a lesser copy of the coordinator that rules only the simulation while answering to the original.
body.title: Twin federates

body.prose: When a run diverges from normal operation, the place of the fault invalidates the result and passes it up; the run ends in indicators that may restart the whole.
body.title: Rehearsal that can refuse

body.prose: The holon travels from a philosophical notion through factory scheduling to grids, construction and twins, each step widening the domain it is asked to order, and the mobility case is its newest ground.
body.title: An idea widening its ground

body.prose: Beside routing, the mobility system is asked to find absence: places with no transport and zones people avoid, discovered as gaps in the flow of data.
body.title: Sensing where nothing is

body.matters: how strongly the claim is held
body.prose: The authors place their roles as analytical constructs rather than implementations, and their case as illustration rather than validation.
body.title: The paper's own standing
